authoritative_reading_rule:
App must read source_of_truth/export_contract.json first.
Primary strategy truth must then be read from Production Core v1:
- outputs/production/current_strategy_snapshot.json
- outputs/production/current_strategy_timeseries.csv
- outputs/production/current_strategy_diagnostics.json
Data/source availability must then be read from the Data Health / Source Availability Guard:
- outputs/production/data_health_report.json
- outputs/production/data_health_report.quality.json
- outputs/production/data_health_report.manifest.json
Runtime authority state must then be read only from:
- outputs/execution/authority/latest_successful_snapshot.json
- outputs/execution/authority/latest_attempt_status.json
Public/runtime consumers must then use the normalized contracts defined in normalized_public_runtime_contracts and must not infer account state from raw model fields.
Production-critical failures block app and execution fail-closed; app-critical failures block app; execution-critical failures block execution; research-only failures block only the relevant research probe; missing optional env/API keys surface as unavailable/warn_only; no silent fallback is allowed.
Candidate BTC in Production Core does not by itself authorize live market exposure; actual_held_asset/current_asset/effective_market_exposure are not real wallet exposure; model equity/paper equity are not real account PnL; model exposure must not be shown as real account exposure.
Legacy app snapshot/runtime/refresh/full_auto_scheduler/runtime_health/live_status paths must not redefine app authority.
default_fallback_rule: If this file is missing or unreadable, only explicit safe app fallbacks may be used; legacy authority paths must not redefine truth or freshness, guarded data/source availability must never degrade through silent fallback, and dashboards must not backfill account state from model fields.
